# principle-laziness-protocol

Inventory what can be deleted. Compare the minimal edit against a new abstraction. Keep a new layer only if a concrete caller or invariant needs it.

Read this leaf before applying it. In the final report, cite this principle only if it changed a specific decision and state that decision.
